reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The TRACE_FD AtomicI32 stores an inherited pipe descriptor borrowed for test tracing; initialize accepts only writable nonblocking FIFO descriptors above 2.
owner_creation.invariant: Trace configuration cannot own pager standard descriptors.
limitations: TRACE_FD stores a borrowed harness pipe number.

aliases_escapes.analysis: Only the TRACE_FD integer is copied into write_marker; each event buffer is stack-owned for the synchronous write and is not retained.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Trace calls borrow event bytes only for one syscall.
limitations: The integer does not prevent the harness from ending the pipe lifetime.

callback_targets.analysis: write_marker calls libc signal-mask and write functions directly; the TRACE_FD descriptor value is not interpreted as a function pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: Trace descriptor storage cannot be a callback target.
limitations: write_marker writes directly and retains no hook callback.

invalidation.analysis: The harness must keep the pipe selected by TRACE_FD live until child exit; FD_CLOEXEC retires that reference on helper exec.
invalidation.invariant: A live plan requires the same inherited trace pipe.

mutation_commit.analysis: Descriptor inspection and FD_CLOEXEC setup succeed before TRACE_FD is stored and the enabled site is Release-published.
mutation_commit.invariant: A descriptor is published only after validation.

release_pair.analysis: TRACE_FD is borrowed descriptor metadata: the hook never dup/closes it, and exec or process exit retires the child pipe reference.
release_pair.invariant: Hook code does not close the harness trace descriptor.
limitations: TRACE_FD storage must not be treated as permission to close a pager FD.

error_cleanup.analysis: Invalid pipe metadata prevents TRACE_FD publication; bounded failed writes produce no valid marker and free no application data.
error_cleanup.invariant: Trace failure changes evidence, not pager ownership.

signals_handoff.analysis: write_marker uses TRACE_FD under a temporarily saved signal mask; it preserves existing SIGPIPE state and hit restores application errno.
signals_handoff.invariant: Trace I/O preserves caller signal-mask ownership.
limitations: Initialize once before handler registration; M0-SIG-002 caller allocation/queue hazards remain open and are not cleared by this storage review.

finding_context.M0-SIG-002: TRACE_FD borrows a validated inherited pipe and the bounded marker path preserves local signal state. M0-SIG-002 still concerns lookup and queue allocation before the hook; pipe provenance does not approve that asynchronous caller.
